description: Send feedback to the QuBe Sync team about something in this server, its guides, or the v2 API that confused you, so we can fix it. Use it when a tool description or guide was unclear or contradicted what actually happened, an error didn't say how to fix it, you had to guess a parameter, endpoint, or behavior, or you couldn't find a way to do what your user needed. Make one call per problem, after you've got past it or given up, and put what the answer turned out to be in `answer`. Not for praise, and not for bugs in your user's own app. The QuBe Sync team stores and reads these reports: never include API keys, webhook secrets, your user's code, or QuickBooks data such as customer names and amounts -- describe the problem in terms of our tools and docs.

agent.description: Your client and model, e.g. "Claude Code / claude-opus-5-5".

answer.description: What actually worked, or what the docs should have said. The most useful part of a report.

details.description: What you were trying to do, what you expected, and what happened instead.

kind.description: unclear: a description or guide left you unsure what to do. wrong: it contradicted what actually happened. unhelpful_error: an error didn't say how to fix it. missing: you couldn't find a way to do what you needed.

outcome.description: resolved: you found the right answer. worked_around: you did something else instead. blocked: you couldn't continue.

subject.description: The tool, endpoint, or guide involved, e.g. "create_invoice", "POST /api/v2/workflow-templates/{key}/install", "get_workflow_authoring_guide".

summary.description: One line naming the problem and where it is, e.g. "create_invoice: unclear whether a line's item takes a name or a ListID".

name: report_confusion

stored.description: false when this address has already sent its limit of reports this hour; don't retry.

title: Report confusion
